title: Luxurious Flaky Portuguese Fish Skillet
description: A rich and flavorful Portuguese dish featuring caramelized sugar sauce and flaky fish, perfect for a solo dinner, this keto friendly recipe is made in a traditional cazuela vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the cod fillet with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the butter to the cazuela and let it melt.
Add the minced garlic to the cazuela and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced onion to the cazuela and cook until it is caramelized.
Add the sugar to the cazuela and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine to the cazuela and cook until the liquid is reduced by half.
Add the lemon juice to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Add the cod fillet to the cazuela and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes.
